title: Dtc Tokenized Entitlement Record Sovereignty Map
question: Explain system: Dtc Tokenized Entitlement Record Sovereignty Map?
bluf: 'The token is a programmable representation inside DTC's entitlement ledger, not an autonomous bearer share and not an issuer-register substitute.' The issuer/transfer-agent register (Cede & Co.) controls registered ownership. DTC's books hold the participant entitlement, with the Digital Omnibus Account and LedgerScan as DTC's official token records. The participant's books hold the customer interest. The chain records movement, but DTC can mint, burn, pause, freeze, claw back and force-transfer without keys. Key control is not legal entitlement. Exit to direct registration requires detokenization, then DRS/FAST/DWAC. SEC action is a revocable staff no-action position, and the contest between issuer-sponsored and DTC-entitlement tokenization is unresolved.
